included: Current main source paths and ownership boundaries for CRM, tasks, catalog, notifications, jobs and actions across Luzione-API, Luzione-UI and Sultan-OS.
Reconciliation of current source evidence with the accepted bounded G0 SGO-C01 inventory.
Unavailable runtime, deployment, provider and cross-repository ownership evidence recorded explicitly.
excluded: Runtime or production queries, provider calls, route activation, migrations, source code changes, contract changes, deployment, or business mutations.
Claims of deployed reachability, active schedules, provider availability, authenticated cross-system readback, durable receipt/replay, or production outcome.

prior_evidence.accepted_claim: Bounded G0 source-path inventory of visible chat, quote review, task assist, simulation, memory and command surfaces, with exact source pins at the then-current API/UI/Sultan commits.
known_limitations: The inventory pins API 7ee5a0a53a3434c3e00969dc626a4daad33f9dc0, UI 84f0dcecbe5aff2d29176433967a6ae0223d9214 and Sultan ea50caa66f09b14b1ac2bcfdfb74cdf9f4c067f0, not the current heads listed above.

Its handoff explicitly leaves authenticated deployed source/readback, persisted cross-system receipt/replay, consumer integration, exact preview exercise, provider/configuration availability and production observation unproven.
This GE-F01 report updates source findings from current main trees; it does not upgrade SGO-C01 or GE-F01 beyond source-inventory evidence.

evidence_model.basis: Repository source, checked-in configuration and migrations only; references below are pinned to the repository_heads commit for their repository.
evidence_model.negative_search_claims: A missing call site in a source-tree search is not proof that a deployed or external consumer does not exist.

owner_assignment.api_candidate_writer: CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-API, feature-gated command path; not established as active

runtime_producers.producer: GET /api/sales/leads calls listLeadsWithScore; POST calls createLeadAtomically.
runtime_producers.persistence: The lead-create service writes PostgreSQL crm_lead_create_receipts, crm_people and crm_leads with a readback check.
runtime_producers.role: Visible UI-owned route and write service; lead reads are a composite projection, not a single-source read.

runtime_producers.producer: Sales routes use relationshipCrmStore for account/person/opportunity reads and writes; the account route also calls canonicalAccountService.
runtime_producers.persistence: PostgreSQL crm_accounts, crm_people, crm_opportunities and crm_relationship_activities.
runtime_producers.role: UI service ownership is visible; parallel relationship and canonical service paths make a single canonical writer/reconciliation policy unclear.

runtime_producers.producer: canonicalCrmRepository through canonical account/contact/lead/opportunity/task services; referenced by signal, project, intelligence and commercial-intake code.
runtime_producers.persistence: PostgreSQL CRM tables when configured, with a local JSON fallback in the repository implementation.
runtime_producers.role: A second CRM service family exists; actual production use and reconciliation with relationshipCrmStore are unavailable.

runtime_producers.producer: GET/POST /api/v1/commands/leads uses LeadCommercialCaseStore; POST requires domainCommandsEnabledForTenant and returns DOMAIN_MUTATIONS_DISABLED when the tenant cutover is not enabled.
runtime_producers.persistence: API command and receipt path targets API CRM tables, including crm_leads.
runtime_producers.role: Potential overlapping writer exists in source. Current deployment flag, route reachability and any successful writes are not observed.

conflicts_and_unknowns: The current API truthRegistry still sets Account, Contact, Lead and Opportunity mutationOwner to null and ownershipState to UNRESOLVED.

Luzione-UI has relationshipCrmStore, canonicalCrmRepository and composite crmCommand read paths; no current evidence establishes one global CRM source of truth or a reconciliation contract among them.
Luzione-API has a command writer for crm_leads but its tenant cutover state and deployed use are unavailable; do not promote it to active ownership.
The exact source and authoritative owner for CRM records outside the named PostgreSQL paths are unavailable.

owner_assignment.company_task_workspace: CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-UI owns the team-coordination route/store implementation for team_coordination_tasks.
owner_assignment.api_workflow_task_reference: CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-API owns P111 human_task_refs as workflow references, not as the task record itself.
owner_assignment.sultan_task_assistance: CIBOTFLOW/Sultan-OS owns no Luzione task truth; task-assist output is advisory.

runtime_producers.producer: GET/POST /api/team-coordination plus task-specific routes call teamCoordinationStore.
runtime_producers.persistence: PostgreSQL team_coordination_tasks and related task events when configured; local JSON fallback is present in source.
runtime_producers.role: Primary source-code owner for the company task workspace, but live persistence mode is unknown.

runtime_producers.producer: GET /api/sales/tasks reads salesOpsStore; POST is guarded by requireLegacyRouteMutation and is blocked in production runtime.
runtime_producers.role: Legacy/parallel task path; not the production task writer according to its own quarantine guard.

runtime_producers.producer: canonicalTaskService is invoked by canonical lead/SLA workflows.
runtime_producers.persistence: canonicalCrmRepository task records, distinct from the team-coordination task store at the service boundary.
runtime_producers.role: Additional task record path; linkage and owner continuity are not established.

runtime_producers.producer: P111 workflow delivery store and p111_human_task_refs.
runtime_producers.role: Workflow reference/continuation evidence only; not proof that API creates, updates or owns the underlying UI task.

conflicts_and_unknowns: The current API truthRegistry still sets Task mutationOwner to null and ownershipState to UNRESOLVED.
Task workspace, legacy sales tasks and CRM/SLA tasks are separate producer paths; one enterprise-wide task owner is not established.
Whether the UI JSON fallback or Postgres is serving deployed tasks, and whether P111 references are linked to those records, are unavailable.

findings.authoritative_owner: Shopify for Shopify product and variant source records

runtime_producers.surface: Shopify product sync and read model
runtime_producers.producer: Shopify sync routes and the configured /api/cron/shopify-catalog handler call Shopify integration code and update the UI read model.
runtime_producers.persistence: shopify_products_read_model and shopify_sync_runs when UI database configuration is present; fallback/local state exists in the store implementation.
runtime_producers.role: UI integration and projection; product source remains Shopify.

runtime_producers.producer: GET /api/v1/catalog and /api/v1/catalog/shopify/projections expose API catalog projection surfaces.
runtime_producers.role: API-owned contract/projection, not the Shopify product source.

conflicts_and_unknowns: API truthRegistry marks Product as Shopify-authoritative and P113 projection-confirmed, while mutationOwner and catalog business owner remain null/unresolved.
UI and API maintain distinct catalog projections. No current source evidence establishes shared projection freshness, a single cross-repository sync producer, or deployed projection equivalence.
UI vercel.json lists a Shopify catalog cron schedule, but registration, secrets, execution history and current source readback in the deployed environment were not observed.
Ownership of non-provider editorial/catalog content and product lead-time metadata is not resolved by this inventory.

runtime_producers.surface: Communications timeline, SLA, follow-up and outbound approval endpoints
runtime_producers.producer: CommunicationsService delegates to CommunicationsRepository; routes persist messages, links, classifications, SLA clocks, follow-ups and outbound approval requests.
runtime_producers.persistence: communication_threads, communication_messages, communication_entity_links, communication_classifications, communication_sla_clocks, communication_follow_up_queue and communication_outbound_approval_queue.
runtime_producers.role: Communication record/work queue implementation; outbound approval queue is not evidence of a sent notification.

runtime_producers.producer: P110 command store writes generic outbox messages; ProviderWorkerRuntime plus PostgresWorkflowDeliveryStore define dispatch and reconciliation mechanics.
runtime_producers.role: Shared delivery reliability ledger/runtime code; source tree has no ProviderWorkerRuntime construction/call site or notification-specific domain producer.

conflicts_and_unknowns: No notification-specific producer, notification source-of-truth contract, or outbound sender owner is established across the three current source trees.
API outbox/provider machinery is generic and does not make API the owner of notification content or delivery policy.
Current worker registration, provider enablement, delivery receipts and source readback are unavailable.

runtime_producers.producer: vercel.json declares growth-signals, property-signals, target-partner-enrichment, shopify-catalog, partner-order-automation and room-planner-portfolio schedules; handlers are under src/app/api/cron.
runtime_producers.role: Source-configured schedule and business-job handler owner. Deployed schedule activation, last run, credentials and results are not observed.

runtime_producers.producer: ProviderWorkerRuntime and PostgresWorkflowDeliveryStore expose batch claim/dispatch/reconcile methods; /api/v1/workflows is a static GET catalog endpoint.
runtime_producers.role: API owns shared delivery/workflow mechanics and state contracts; no scheduler registration or ProviderWorkerRuntime call site was found in current API source.

runtime_producers.producer: POST /api/system/agent-runtime-v2/runs invokes persisted Sultan run logic with SHADOW admitted and ASSISTED/CANARY requiring explicit environment and case admission; run/event/receipt persistence is defined in Sultan source and migrations.
runtime_producers.role: Sultan agent execution, not a generic Luzione business-job scheduler. Current UI main has no source call to this Runtime V2 route in the searched tree; SGO-C01's older pinned inventory also rejected promotion of shadow paths to visible producers.

conflicts_and_unknowns: No single owner or registry for all Luzione scheduled jobs is established.
Checked-in Vercel schedules do not prove deployment registration or successful runtime execution.
API batch worker code has no current source-tree invocation site; any external scheduler/worker is unavailable.
Sultan agent runtime schedule/trigger ownership and deployed caller are unavailable; do not equate agent run receipts with Luzione job completion.

owner_assignment.provider_delivery_receipt_and_reconcilia: CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-API for P110-backed API commands only

runtime_producers.producer: POST /api/action-intents stages supported intents; the action-intent worker applies policy, approvals, executor selection, execution record and failure/dead-letter handling.
runtime_producers.role: UI owns this action-intent lifecycle implementation. A separate /execute legacy route is blocked in production by requireLegacyRouteMutation; current executor/provider enablement is not observed.

runtime_producers.producer: POST /api/sultan/chat/actions stages and routes action intents through UI approval/execution services.
runtime_producers.role: Sultan can propose/assist through the UI surface; UI governance and configured executor own any admitted business/provider effect.

runtime_producers.surface: P110 command and Sultan internal action journal
runtime_producers.producer: P110 persists command receipts/events/outbox; sultan_agent_internal_actions records the API's admitted internal tool-action lifecycle.
runtime_producers.role: API owns these command and internal-action records/contracts; they are not a universal business action executor or proof of source-system effect.

runtime_producers.producer: Sultan Runtime V2 records agent runs, events, tool receipts and approval-bound resumptions.
runtime_producers.role: Sultan owns reasoning/runtime records; this does not transfer CRM, task, catalog or other Luzione business-object ownership.

conflicts_and_unknowns: Action authority is action-type/provider specific; this inventory cannot assign one owner to all business effects.
API action journals, P110 receipts and Sultan tool receipts must not be treated as source-system readback or business outcome.
The deployed UI route, executor map, provider credentials/flags, and per-action authoritative source/readback are unavailable.

The older SGO-C01 source inventory found the visible chat drawer's nine action types resolving to UI plan/action-intent executors, while the current UI tree does not establish a live current consumer of Sultan Runtime V2.

cross_domain_owner_map.CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-UI: Owns human-facing workflows and the named UI route/service implementations in this report. This does not by itself prove UI as authoritative business-data owner for every CRM/task/catalog/effect entity.
cross_domain_owner_map.CIBOTFLOW/Luzione-API: Owns shared API contracts, P110 command/outbox reliability mechanics, P111 workflow state/reference mechanics and P113 catalog projection contract/store. The current truth registry leaves the business mutation owner unresolved for CRM and Task and marks Workflow transfer pending.
cross_domain_owner_map.CIBOTFLOW/Sultan-OS: Owns Sultan reasoning/runtime and agent-run/tool/memory records. It is not the owner of Luzione operational business truth.

remaining_gates: Controller acceptance or rejection of this bounded GE-F01 G0 source inventory.
Resolve the canonical CRM writer/readback and overlap among UI relationship, canonical and composite read paths; reconcile with the API default-off lead command candidate.
Name task owners by task subtype and establish continuity among team_coordination_tasks, CRM/SLA tasks, sales task paths and P111 references.
Name a cross-repository catalog projection/freshness contract and verify the deployed Shopify sync registration and readback.
Identify the notification sender/policy owner and connect communication records/approval queue to an actual provider delivery and source readback path.
Identify deployed job scheduler registrations and current run/readback state; establish whether API worker code has an external caller.
Assign business-object and source-readback ownership per action type/provider before treating any receipt as completed business state.
For any later G1 claim, obtain authenticated deployed source/readback, durable receipt/replay, exact consumer pinning, preview runtime exercise and recovery evidence.

handoff_for_ge_f04.usable_now: Exact source-level producer and ownership-boundary map at the three current main commits above.
not_established: One global authoritative CRM or Task owner.
Deployed runtime use of any route, worker, cron, provider or cross-repository consumer.
Integration, source readback, receipt/replay, preview or production outcome.
handoff_for_ge_f04.recommended_gate: Use this inventory to choose a narrowly scoped owner/path for GE-F04 planning; require the controller to resolve listed ownership conflicts and runtime evidence before any integration or G1 promotion.
